purpose: Measure voluntary engagement without identity profiling.

consent.beforeConsent: No analytics script, identifier, event, or queued history.
consent.afterWithdrawal: Stop collection, remove analytics tokens, and request deletion of token-linked records; completed aggregates cannot identify the participant.
consent.preferenceStorage: Store only the minimum choice record; no identifier required for decline.

activeReaders.meaning: Approximate opted-in active sessions, not people.
activeReaders.expiry: Short heartbeat timeout; exact duration requires design.
activeReaders.publicDisplay: Delay or suppress small counts; never expose individual presence.

articleDailyBrowsers.meaning: Distinct opted-in browser tokens for one article and one day.
articleDailyBrowsers.identity: Independent random article/day token; no stable parent ID.
articleDailyBrowsers.classification: Pseudonymous until token-linked records expire; not anonymous people.
limits: Different browsers, cleared storage, and token resets cause overcounting.
Shared browsers and non-consent cause undercounting.
Daily counts cannot be summed into monthly unique people.

pageViews.meaning: Accepted opted-in public page-view events, not unique people or all traffic.

collection: First-party allowlisted endpoint; enforce consent before dispatch and again at ingestion where verifiable. Discard unrecognized fields.
operationalData: Transport and hosting providers can process IPs and request metadata. Essential auth/security records are separate, restricted, and disclosed; never reuse them for audience analytics.

retention.rawEvents: Prefer aggregate-on-ingest; no event trail by default.
retention.deduplicationTokens: Delete when article/day deduplication window ends.
retention.aggregates: Set and disclose a bounded duration before implementation.
retention.providerLogs: Inventory actual edge, Worker, WAF, and log-export settings before promising retention.

governance.compliance: Publish scope and evidence. Do not claim certification or universal compliance from a manifest.

verification: No analytics network requests or identifier storage before consent.
Declining does not reduce reading features.
Withdrawal stops requests and removes analytics identifiers.
No identifiers persist across article/day boundaries.
Mirrors omit analytics assets, pixels, scripts, and external embeds.
Collector rejects forbidden fields; infrastructure logs do not capture analytics bodies.
Public metrics exclude private documents and suppress small groups.
Expiry removes token-linked records and respects declared retention.
open: Retention durations, heartbeat expiry, and public aggregation thresholds.
Consent enforcement protocol and abuse resistance without analytics fingerprinting.
Processor configuration, jurisdictions, and scoped legal review.

dashboard.guest: Synthetic metrics only; no owner telemetry query or fallback.
dashboard.securitySignals: Separate operational purpose and source from voluntary audience analytics. No reuse for visitor identity profiling.
dashboard.activation: No collection enabled; declare collector contracts, consent or operational basis, allowed fields, retention, and verification first.
